notes.28: Many candidates showed a good understanding of the meaning of electromotive force, but a considerable number thought that e.m.f. was the rate of energy transfer per unit charge, rather than just the energy per unit charge.

notes.32: Almost all candidates recognised that a thermistor was required in order for the potential difference across Y to change. However, having established this important fact, almost as many candidates chose the incorrect option C , as the correct answer, D .
